summary: SS Innovations International filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing that on October 5, 2026 it submitted its response to an FDA Additional Information request letter (AINN) regarding its 510(k) premarket notification for the SSi Mantra surgical robotic system. The response includes final expanded human clinical and human factors validation study data plus final bridging study data completed in August 2026 at Hospital Internacional de Colombia. No financial terms, securities transaction, or corporate action is involved; this is a routine regulatory update with a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. What to watch: FDA clearance timing and any further deficiency letters affecting the SSII commercialization path.
